v3_preview.title: Temporary TV proof (QA only, NO login)
v3_preview.description: Start the 2-minute v3 test on the TV DEBUG app first. Then choose Start here. This exchanges public ephemeral keys and produces an eight-digit code. No HA login or bearer token is shared.

data.start_test: Start the secure code comparison test

v3_code.title: Compare all eight digits on TV and Home Assistant
v3_code.description: Home Assistant code: {code}. Compare all EIGHT digits with the TV screen, then press the TV's physical remote OK button. This proves TV identity only and does not log it into Home Assistant.

data.numbers_match: All eight digits matched and I pressed OK on the actual TV remote

owner_approval.title: Verified TV: confirm the signed-in HA owner (QA only)
owner_approval.description: Physical TV proof passed. In the signed-in HA owner approval panel, optionally select dedicated ongoing login (the HA Users role can control ALL entities), then Approve this TV. Return here and Submit while the TV's pairing window is active. Without the option the test issues no account or token. Code: {code}

data.owner_approved: I clicked Approve this TV in the signed-in HA owner panel

abort.discovery_only: This QA integration only works when a TV debug app advertises the temporary v3 mDNS session.
abort.invalid_discovery: Invalid v3 TV discovery. Restart the temporary pairing test on your TV.
abort.cancelled: Cancelled: your current HA and TV login were not changed.
abort.expired: The temporary test expired. Start again using the TV physical remote.
abort.mismatch: Codes did not match. No pairing or login was changed.
abort.verified_no_login: SUCCESS: The physical TV and secure v3 session were verified. This is NOT a Home Assistant login. Your normal Kellie's Voice setup was not changed.
abort.owner_unavailable: The v3 QA owner registry unexpectedly failed. Check Home Assistant system logs. No login or credentials were changed.
abort.owner_expired: The two-minute owner approval window expired. Restart v3 pairing.
abort.owner_denied: Owner approval was rejected or the Home Assistant account is inactive.
abort.owner_verified_no_login: SUCCESS: v3 TV proof and actual signed-in Home Assistant owner approval are BOTH verified. This test does not log in the TV, create a token, or change existing connections.
abort.owner_setup_missing: The Home Assistant v3 QA approval panel was not initialized at startup. Add kellies_voice_v3qa: to configuration.yaml and restart HA. No login was changed.
abort.owner_binding_rejected: The verified TV owner-claim record was rejected. Check the Home Assistant system logs for v3 QA owner binding. No credential was created.
abort.owner_receipt_verified_no_login: SUCCESS: The authenticated HA owner approved this exact TV, the TV decrypted the encrypted v3 receipt, and HA verified its cryptographic acknowledgement. NO login or token was created; original Kellie's Voice remains unchanged.
abort.owner_receipt_failed: The authenticated owner receipt did not complete or the TV did not cryptographically acknowledge it within the original two-minute window. Restart v3 QA. No credentials or normal TV connections were changed.
abort.owner_login_connected: Dedicated Kellie's Voice TV login activated. Reopen Kellie's Voice Beta to connect to Home Assistant. The TV has a separate non-admin account and renewable credentials.
abort.owner_login_failed: TV owner-approved login could not be completed. The unfinished credential will be revoked on recovery. Restart TV setup. The existing stable Kellie's Voice is untouched.
abort.https_required: Ongoing TV login needs an HTTPS Home Assistant internal or external URL configured under Settings > System > Network. The encrypted owner-approval test still works without one.

error.unavailable: Could not contact the temporary v3 TV test. Start again on the TV.
error.waiting_for_tv: Waiting for the physical TV remote approval. Verify all digits and press OK on the TV.
error.owner_pending: An HA owner has not approved this TV yet. Open the v3 Owner QA panel in another browser tab and click Approve this TV, then retry.
